newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS-Fresenius buys French medical firm.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Fresenius buys French medical firm.

text.p: German medical equipment manufacturer Fresenius AG said on Tuesday it had bought French company Vial Medical Infusion Systems S.A. from Becton Dickinson France S.A to strengthen its activities in the area of infusion technology.

"The purchase of Vial Medical Infusion Systems is a big step forward for us which will help us organise and expand our activities in the medical infusion sector," said Gerhard Krammer, a member of the Fresenius management board.
Fresenius did not disclose the purchase price.
Vial Medical is based in Brezins, France, employs about 120 people and generated sales of about 38 million marks in its 1995/96 business year, Fresenius said in a statement.
Becton Dickinson France S.A. is the French subsidiary of Becton Dickinson & Co in the U.S.
